cost: L script chars, E expression nodes, C commands, N extracted numbers, H state keys, B evolving rational bit length: parsing O(L), literal gate O(E*N) rational comparisons, evaluation sum of rational operation costs at B. Prefix endpoints use O(Smax) integers; final state O(H log H). Recursion and allocations are not bounded.
description: Exact quantity grammar, rational state transitions, sentence-local literal provenance, answer gates and external adapters.
forward: Fold parsed commands over (state, answer, errors). Invalid anchors skip. Extract numbers through largest visited anchor once; gate literals against their current anchor prefix plus IMPLIED, 0, 1 and reciprocal constants. Evaluate exact expressions, skipping on failure. set overwrites; arithmetic requires existing target; move debits and credits only with existing source; ask overwrites answer. check adds parse and gold errors.

Sentence-prefix validation applies only to numeric literals. References read the current command-order state and carry no sentence provenance. Thus @2 set a.x=19 followed by @1 set b.x=a.x and @1 ask b.x remains green when 19 occurs only in sentence 2. This is a documented current limitation, not complete temporal provenance or a proposed behavior change.
inverse: Universe: parsed-command/sentence/result triples with fixed math dependencies and sufficient resources. Inner absent relation excludes green outputs with invalid anchors, undefined references, zero division or foreign literals; missing-source transfers cannot credit destinations. Malformed manually constructed Cmd and resource failure are outside this domain.

For fixed sentences and observation O, retain every command sequence whose fold gives O. Answer-only fibers erase prior asks and overwritten state: set a; add b; ask yields 4 for all five a,b in 0..4 with a+b=4. Bounded fiber enumeration is complete only on that family.
limitations: Partial syntax and source models; finite synthetic evidence.
Text extraction, dictionaries, persistence and teacher effects remain external.

state: Exact rational state; ordered final keys. Green execution requires an ask and no diagnostics but does not prove semantic grounding. Same-key transfer is identity; distinct-key transfer conserves sum. Negative quantities are allowed.
